newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said state-run banks were major net sellers today, indicating a sufficient money supply at the national level.

"The banks have been lending large amount of money in the past few trading days, indicating deposits at the banks are rich," said one trader. "This is because Beijing has been cautiously loosening credit in the past few months."

But traders said the surging domestic A share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen attracted funds from the interbank market, preventing the rates from falling. They expect the rates to move in a narrow box in the short term.
